versions.source: AJCC Cancer Staging Manual 8th Edition / NCCN / UICC
versions.provenance: 8th edition staging, verified against AJCC 8th edition / NCCN guidelines; licensed verification standard. Requires R1 clinical verification before unchecked use.
versions.introduction: Staging applies to squamous cell carcinoma of the anal canal (including the anal margin where it behaves as canal disease). The 8th edition keeps size-based T (2 cm and 5 cm cutoffs) and redefines N by nodal basin rather than number: inguinal, mesorectal and internal iliac (including obturator) nodes form one group, external iliac nodes another. Invasion of sphincter muscle, rectal wall or perianal skin alone does not qualify as T4; T4 requires invasion of an adjacent organ such as vagina, urethra or bladder. HPV/p16 status is prognostic but does not change the anatomic stage group.

t.label: High-grade squamous intraepithelial lesion (previously carcinoma in situ)
Tumour 2 cm or smaller in greatest dimension
Tumour larger than 2 cm up to 5 cm in greatest dimension
Tumour larger than 5 cm in greatest dimension
Tumour invades adjacent organ(s) such as vagina, urethra or bladder; sphincter, rectal wall or skin invasion alone is not T4

n.label: Regional lymph nodes cannot be assessed
Metastasis in inguinal, mesorectal and/or internal iliac (including obturator) nodes
Metastasis in both external iliac and N1a-group nodes

stageGroups.basis: Large or invasive tumour with nodes

versions.regionalNodes: Perirectal (mesorectal), internal iliac (including obturator), external iliac and inguinal nodes. Iliac nodes above the bifurcation and para-aortic nodes are non-regional (M1).
versions.histologicGrade: Well differentiated (G1), moderately differentiated (G2), poorly differentiated (G3), undifferentiated (G4); basaloid and non-keratinising variants graded by the same scale.
versions.histopathologicTypes: Keratinising and non-keratinising (basaloid/cloacogenic) squamous cell carcinoma; adenocarcinoma of anal glands or fistula tracts is staged as rectal cancer, and melanoma and neuroendocrine tumours use their own systems.
prognosticFactors: Nodal basin involvement (N1a vs N1b vs N1c)
